correctness.rationale: For every b>=1 and gcd(u,6)=1, prove S covers all odd N via the finite affine permutation translation A∘B∘(B∘A)^{-1}=t+2 and the three maps realizing residue families modulo 3N. All even residues mod m=2·3^bu follow by doubling. Every odd terminal word is B^j C(s); its exact identity B^j C(s)+1=2·3^j(3s+2) both restricts and exhausts all congruence branches. Disjoint classes count to u(3^{b+1}+1)/2. Haar closure is the compatible inverse limit of these sets; the odd slice has mass sum_{j>=0}3^{-j-1}=1/2. Exact finite BFS checks 70 modulus cases verify the union and cardinality but are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete image-spectrum question is mathematically natural for the specific Klarner orbit in a previously unresolved non-surjective mixed-prime regime. Exact classes for all depths b and every odd cofactor u, plus a 3/4 inverse-limit Haar measure and terminal-word mechanism, are structural advances over an elementary modular obstruction or numerical tables. No claim is made about ordinary natural density or moduli divisible by four.
